name: ego_network
author: afc500fb
description: Extracts the one-hop ego network around a specified node, including the ego, its direct neighbors, and all edges among those nodes. Supports directed and undirected, weighted and unweighted graphs. Use it to inspect a person's immediate social circle or the local neighborhood of a graph node. Returns node references, node and edge counts, and the registered subgraph ID.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyze.

node.description: ID of the ego node whose one-hop neighborhood should be extracted.
